definition_zh: 邀请；招待；招致（麻烦、批评）
definition_en: to ask someone to come somewhere or do something, or to make something likely to happen
core_image: 一扇门被推开，主人朝外伸出手做个「请进」的姿势
scene: 周末的厨房里炖着汤，主人擦擦手，走到门口朝对面的邻居招手。She invited the whole street to dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 invite 是「邀请」（第 1 个义项：请别人来），句意为她请了整条街的人来吃晚饭。画面里的物件：汤锅、门口、手巾。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「邀请；邀请函」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「诱人的」
由本词加 -ee 构成，义为「被邀请者」
由本词加 -ional 构成，义为「邀请制的」

senses.title: Asking someone to come
senses.definition: to ask a person politely to come to an event or a place
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地请人到某个活动或某个地方来
senses.example: They invited us to the wedding in June.
senses.exampleCN: 他们邀请我们参加六月的婚礼。
senses.why: Latin invitare meant "to ask, to entertain", with no need for a written card.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 invitare 意为「邀请、款待」，那时还不需要请柬。

senses.title: Offering hospitality
senses.definition: to receive someone as a guest and provide food or lodging
senses.definitionCN: 把某人当客人接来，并提供饭食或住处
senses.example: A neighbour invited the stranded family in for tea.
senses.exampleCN: 一位邻居把滞留的那家人请进屋喝茶。
senses.why: The same verb covers the welcome itself, not just the asking.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也涵盖「招待」这件事，而不只是开口请。

senses.title: Bringing trouble on yourself
senses.definition: to make something bad or unwanted more likely by your own action
senses.definitionCN: 因为自己的举动让不好的事情更容易发生
senses.example: Leaving the gate open invites trouble at night.
senses.exampleCN: 夜里不关院门是会招来麻烦的。
senses.why: The "trouble" sense is the welcoming gesture aimed at something harmful.
senses.whyCN: 「招麻烦」义就是同一个欢迎手势，只是指向了有害的东西。

senses.title: Welcoming a response
senses.definition: to openly welcome comments, questions, or applications
senses.definitionCN: 公开表示乐于接受意见、提问或报名
senses.example: The paper invites readers to send in photographs.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报纸欢迎读者寄来照片。
senses.why: A request for replies is still an invitation, only written to many at once.
senses.whyCN: 征集回应仍是邀请，只不过一次写给许多人。

intro.en: Invite has kept its original meaning of asking and welcoming almost unchanged for two thousand years.
intro.cn: invite 两千年来几乎原封不动地保留了「邀请、款待」的原意。

items.en: invitare meant "to ask, to treat as a guest".
items.cn: invitare 意为「邀请、当客人款待」。

items.en: The noun invitatus recorded the welcoming of a guest.
items.cn: 名词 invitatus 记载了对客人的接待。

items.en: French had inviter, used for asking someone over.
items.cn: 法语有 inviter，用于请人过来。

items.en: English shortened the French verb to invite.
items.cn: 英语把法语动词缩成 invite。

items.en: The sense of inviting trouble grew from the idea of welcoming.
items.cn: 「招来麻烦」义从「迎接」的想法里长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the invi- opening; the near-meaning group holds words for asking people in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 invi- 开头；近义组收表示请人进来的词。

entries.definition: A spoken or written request to come.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「邀请；请柬」，同族词。

entries.definition: To put money or effort in.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「投资」，开头相同。

entries.definition: To make something new.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「发明」，只差一个字母。

entries.definition: The general verb for requesting.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「请；问」，最泛。

entries.definition: To greet someone with pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「欢迎」，强调态度。

entries.definition: To order someone to come.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「传唤」，带命令色彩。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the word at a door being held open.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它放在一扇被扶开的门口。

normal.en: The old verb invitare meant to ask and to treat well.
normal.cn: 古动词 invitare 既指邀请，也指好好招待。

normal.en: What arrives in the post is an invitation.
normal.cn: 寄到手里的东西叫 invitation。

normal.en: The person who receives it is the invitee.
normal.cn: 收到邀请的人叫 invitee。

normal.en: Leave a door open and you invite the wind.
normal.cn: 门留着不关，就是把风请进来。

normal.en: Invite a question and you are glad to hear it.
normal.cn: invite questions 就是欢迎别人提问。

abstract.en: Invitation is a door left open on purpose.
abstract.cn: 邀请就是一扇有意留开的门。

abstract.en: Whatever you welcome decides what follows you home.
abstract.cn: 你欢迎什么，什么就跟你回家。

abstract.en: Inviting trouble is the same gesture, aimed badly.
abstract.cn: 招麻烦是同一个手势，只是指错了方向。

examples.en: She invited two former students back to speak at the school.
examples.cn: 她请了两位往届学生回校演讲。

examples.en: The narrow path invites people to walk faster than they should.
examples.cn: 这条窄路会引诱人走得比该有的速度快。

examples.en: The magazine invites letters from readers of any age.
examples.cn: 这本杂志欢迎任何年龄的读者来信。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（进来）+ vite（拉丁 invitare 邀请）——请你进来

root: 拉丁语 invitare「邀请；款待」→ 古法语 inviter → 英语 invite。同族有 invitation、invitee、inviting。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: asking someone over, receiving a guest, drawing trouble, and welcoming replies.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：请人来、招待客人、招来麻烦，以及欢迎回应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand held out as the door opens.
core.cn: 核心意象：门开时伸出的那只手。

branches.en: THE CARD: a written or spoken request to come.
branches.cn: 请柬这条线：写出来或说出口的请。

branches.en: THE TABLE: food and shelter given to a guest.
branches.cn: 饭桌这条线：给客人的饭食与住处。

branches.en: THE GATE: an open entry that lets trouble in.
branches.cn: 院门这条线：留开的通道把麻烦放进来。

branches.en: THE OPENNESS: both senses come from a willing yes.
branches.cn: 敞开这条线：两个义项都源于一个乐意的「好」。

branches.en: THE RESULT: what you welcome decides what arrives.
branches.cn: 结果这条线：你欢迎什么，就决定什么到来。

intro.en: Invite keeps a single Latin stem, invit-, plus the verb ending -e.
intro.cn: invite 由一个拉丁词干 invit- 加动词尾 -e 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin invitare and invitatus are both recorded with the friendly sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 invitare 与 invitatus 均有记载，都带友好的意味。

items.example: The root survives in invite and invitation.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根仍见于 invite 与 invitation。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.
The participle shows the noun form.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词显示名词形式。

definition_zh: 涉及；包含；使卷入；需要
definition_en: to include someone or something as a necessary part, or to draw a person into an activity or problem
core_image: 一张卷起的纸，把旁边的东西一层层包进去
scene: 事故现场拉着警戒线，几个路过的人也被记录成了证人。The delay involved three separate repairs and two inspections.
sceneCN: 这里 involve 是「涉及」（第 1 个义项：把某事作为组成部分包含在内），句意为这次延误涉及三轮维修和两次检查。画面里的物件：警戒线、记录本、铁皮。

pos.zh: 动词：涉及；包含；使卷入；需要

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ment 构成，义为「参与；牵连」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「复杂的；有关的」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「引人入胜的」
同带 volv- 词根的形近词，义为「进化；演变」

senses.title: Having something as a part
senses.definition: to include something as a necessary part of a process or situation
senses.definitionCN: 把某物作为过程或情形中必要的一部分包含进来
senses.example: The job involves long hours in cold rooms.
senses.exampleCN: 这份工作需要长时间待在冷库里。
senses.why: involvere rolled things inside; a job that includes a task has rolled the task in.
senses.whyCN: involvere 是把东西卷在里面；一份工作含有某项任务，就是把它卷了进来。

senses.title: Drawing people in
senses.definition: to make someone take part in or be affected by something
senses.definitionCN: 使人参与某事或受到某事影响
senses.example: The decision involved every member of the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定牵涉到村里的每一个人。
senses.why: People wrapped into a matter are involved parties, whether they wished it or not.
senses.whyCN: 被卷进一件事的人就是当事方，愿不愿意都一样。

senses.title: Being complicated
senses.definition: to become difficult because many parts are tangled together
senses.definitionCN: 因为许多部分缠在一起而变得难以处理
senses.example: The case grew more involved with each new witness.
senses.exampleCN: 随着新证人出现，这个案子变得越来越复杂。
senses.why: Many threads rolled tight make a knot: that is the complicated sense.
senses.whyCN: 许多线被紧紧卷在一起就成了结，这就是「复杂」那一层。

intro.en: Involve comes from Latin involvere, "to roll up, to wrap", which is literally a paper rolled around something.
intro.cn: involve 来自拉丁语 involvere「卷起、包裹」，字面就是纸把东西卷进去。

items.en: The verb volvere meant "to roll".
items.cn: 动词 volvere 意为「滚、卷」。

items.en: in- added the idea of inward motion, giving involvere, "to roll in".
items.cn: in- 加上向内，构成 involvere「卷进去」。

items.en: The verb was used of wrapping things in cloth or mist.
items.cn: 这个词被用来指用布或雾把东西包起来。

items.en: French took it in as involver, "to wrap up".
items.cn: 法语以 involver「包裹」吸收它。

items.en: The wrapped sense turned into the social sense of being entangled in a matter.
items.cn: 「包住」义转成在社会事务中被缠住的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -volve stem; the near-meaning group holds words for including or entangling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -volve 词干；近义组收表示包含或牵连的词。

entries.definition: To develop gradually over time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「演变」，同一词干换前缀。

entries.definition: To turn around a centre.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「旋转」，同词干。

entries.definition: Complicated, or taking part in something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「复杂的；有关的」，同族词。

entries.definition: To have something as part of a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「包括」，最中性。

entries.definition: To make something necessary as a result.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「必然涉及」，偏后果。

entries.definition: To twist into a complicated situation.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「缠住」，偏麻烦。

normalIntro.en: These hooks all start with a sheet of paper being rolled up.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子都从一张被卷起的纸开始。

normal.en: in- means in, and volv- means roll.
normal.cn: in- 是「向内」，volv- 是「卷」。

normal.en: Involve is to roll something into the middle.
normal.cn: involve 就是把东西卷到里面去。

normal.en: What gets rolled in is involved in the affair.
normal.cn: 被卷进去的，就是牵扯其中的。

normal.en: Revolve rolls around an axis; evolve rolls out.
normal.cn: revolve 绕轴卷，evolve 向外卷开。

normal.en: Adding -ment gives the state of involvement.
normal.cn: 加 -ment 就是 involvement 这个状态。

abstract.en: To involve is to fold someone into the story.
abstract.cn: involve 就是把某人褶进这个故事里。

abstract.en: Every wrapped thing has edges you did not plan.
abstract.cn: 每一个被包住的东西都有你没算到的折角。

abstract.en: Complication is many threads rolled tight.
abstract.cn: 复杂就是许多线被紧紧卷在一起。

examples.en: The repair involves replacing the whole pump.
examples.cn: 这次维修要更换整个水泵。

examples.en: Parents were involved in planning the new playground.
examples.cn: 家长参与了新游乐场的筹划。

examples.en: Keep the story simple; the readers do not want an involved plot.
examples.cn: 故事写简单些，读者不想要错综复杂的情节。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（进去）+ volve（卷）——被卷进来

root: 拉丁语 in「进入」+ volvere「卷」→ involvere「卷进去、包裹」→ 古法语 involver → 英语 involve。同族有 involvement、involved；形近 revolve、evolve。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: including a part, drawing people in, and becoming tangled and complex.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：包含组成部分、把人牵进来，以及变得盘根错节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet rolled inward until other things are inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸向内卷起，把别的东西也裹了进去。

branches.en: THE STEPS: what a job or plan must contain.
branches.cn: 步骤这条线：一份工作或计划必须含有的环节。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE: everyone rolled into the matter.
branches.cn: 人物这条线：被卷进这件事的所有人。

branches.en: THE KNOT: a case too tangled to explain quickly.
branches.cn: 绳结这条线：复杂到一时说不清的案子。

branches.en: THE WEB: parts and people are bound by the same thread.
branches.cn: 网这条线：组成部分与人被同一根线连着。

branches.en: THE COST: drawing people in is what makes things complicated.
branches.cn: 代价这条线：把人牵进来，事情才变复杂。

intro.en: Involve is in- "into" plus volv- "roll".
intro.cn: involve 是 in-「进入」加 volv-「卷」。

latinIntro.en: Latin volvere and involvere are both recorded roll-words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 volvere 与 involvere 都是有记载的「卷」类词。

items.example: The root also drives revolve and evolve.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也带动 revolve 与 evolve。

items.example: It forms involved, tangled or related.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 involved，纠结或有关的。
它构成 involving，引人入胜的。

items.example: The verb is the family base.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一族的基座。

items.example: The re- prefix sends it around.
The e- prefix rolls it outward.
items.exampleCN: e- 前缀把它向外卷开。

definition_zh: 参与；投入；牵连；涉及
definition_en: the state of taking part in something or of being connected with it, often as a matter of responsibility
core_image: 一只手伸进正在运转的机器里，成了它的一部分
scene: 社区中心墙上贴着排班表，好几位老人每周都来分菜。Her involvement in the food bank began with one afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 involvement 是「参与」（第 1 个义项：主动投入某项活动），句意为她在食品银行的参与从某一个下午开始。画面里的物件：排班表、菜筐、记号笔。

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -ment 构成，义为「涉及；使卷入」
由动词加 -ed 构成，义为「参与的；复杂的」
同以 in- 开头、invol- 词干的形近词，义为「非自愿的」

senses.title: Taking an active part
senses.definition: the fact of actively giving your time or effort to an activity
senses.definitionCN: 主动把时间或精力投入到某项活动中的事实
senses.example: Her involvement in the choir gave her a way to make friends.
senses.exampleCN: 参加合唱团让她找到了交朋友的方式。
senses.why: The -ment noun turns the act of joining in into a lasting relation.
senses.whyCN: -ment 名词把「加入」这个动作变成一种持续的关系。

senses.title: Being connected to a trouble
senses.definition: the state of being linked to an accident, crime, or scandal
senses.definitionCN: 与事故、犯罪或丑闻被联系在一起的状态
senses.example: He denied any involvement in the theft.
senses.exampleCN: 他否认与这起盗窃有任何牵连。
senses.why: Here the wrapping is unwanted: a name rolled into a police file.
senses.whyCN: 这里的包裹是不情愿的：一个名字被卷进了警方的卷宗。

senses.title: Emotional commitment
senses.definition: a deep personal interest or feeling that makes leaving hard
senses.definitionCN: 一种让人难以抽身的深切私人兴趣或情感
senses.example: Her emotional involvement in the case tested her judgement.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这个案子的情感投入影响了她的判断。
senses.why: Feeling can be wrapped in too, and that is the heaviest kind of involvement.
senses.whyCN: 情感也会被卷进去，那是最沉的一种投入。

intro.en: Involvement is the noun from involve, which began as Latin involvere, "to wrap".
intro.cn: involvement 是 involve 的名词，而 involve 起初就是拉丁 involvere「包裹」。

items.en: volvere meant "to roll".
items.cn: volvere 意为「滚、卷」。

items.en: involvere meant "to roll in, to wrap".
items.cn: involvere 意为「卷进、包裹」。

items.en: French passed the verb in as involver.
items.cn: 法语以 involver 传入这个动词。

items.en: English added -ment to name the state of being wrapped in.
items.cn: 英语加 -ment 指「被包进去」的状态。

items.en: Modern usage splits the noun into participation and complicity.
items.cn: 现代用法把这个名词分成「参与」与「牵连」两面。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the involv- stem; the near-meaning group holds words for taking part.
note.cn: 形近组共用 involv- 词干；近义组收表示参与的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to include or entangle.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「涉及；卷入」，同族词。

entries.definition: Money put in for a return.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「投资」，开头相近。

entries.definition: Done without a choice.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「非自愿的」，同前缀。

entries.definition: The act of taking part in something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「参与」，最直接的对等词。

entries.definition: A promise and the effort to keep it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「投入；承诺」。

entries.definition: Involvement in wrongdoing with others.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「同谋」，只用于坏事。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the noun back to a rolled-up sheet.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把这个名词系回一张卷好的纸。

normal.en: It is involve plus -ment, the state itself.
normal.cn: 它是 involve 加 -ment，指那个状态本身。

normal.en: You roll into an activity: that is involvement.
normal.cn: 你把自己卷进一项活动，这就是参与。

normal.en: You can roll into trouble just as easily.
normal.cn: 同样容易把自己卷进麻烦里。

normal.en: The -ment turns the act into a lasting condition.
normal.cn: -ment 把动作变成一种持续的状态。

normal.en: Denying involvement is a sentence you hear after scandals.
normal.cn: 丑闻之后总能听到「否认牵连」这句话。

abstract.en: Involvement is the footprint of an interest.
abstract.cn: 参与就是兴趣留下的脚印。

abstract.en: Being inside is warmth and also weight.
abstract.cn: 身在其中，既是温度也是重量。

abstract.en: Once wrapped in, you never unwrap completely.
abstract.cn: 一旦被卷进来，就很难完全卷出去。

examples.en: The school credits its success to parent involvement.
examples.cn: 学校把成功归功于家长的参与。

examples.en: The report found no involvement of local officials.
examples.cn: 报告认定没有当地官员牵涉其中。

examples.en: Her deep involvement with the study left little time for sleep.
examples.cn: 她对这个研究投入极深，几乎没时间睡觉。

dict_mnemonic.text: involve（卷入）+ ment（状态）——被卷进去的那种状态

root: 拉丁语 involvere「卷进去」→ involve → 加 -ment 成 involvement。同族有 involve、involved；形近 investment、involuntary。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: active part, connection to trouble, and emotional commitment.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：主动参与、与麻烦的牵连，以及感情上的投入。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching into a running machine and staying there.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸进运转的机器并留在里面。

branches.en: THE ROTA: hours written on a board and given away.
branches.cn: 排班表这条线：写在板上、交付出去的时间。

branches.en: THE RECORD: a name placed at a scene of trouble.
branches.cn: 记录这条线：名字被放到出事的地方。

branches.en: THE HEART: a case that will not let go of you.
branches.cn: 心这条线：一个放不下手的案子。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses are a tie between person and event.
branches.cn: 关联这条线：两个义项都是人与事件的连带。

branches.en: THE COST: what you give yourself to takes something back.
branches.cn: 代价这条线：你付出给的事也会取走些什么。

intro.en: Involvement is in- "into", volv- "roll", and -ment naming the state.
intro.cn: involvement 是 in-「进入」、volv-「卷」与标出状态的 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The family rests on Latin volvere and involvere, both recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 这一族立足的拉丁语 volvere 与 involvere 均有记载。

items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的后盾。

items.example: The simplest member of the family.
A cousin that keeps the rolling image.

definition_zh: 铁；熨斗；熨烫；链条（复数）
definition_en: a strong grey metal, a heated tool for smoothing cloth, or the act of pressing clothes with it
core_image: 一块灰黑色的金属锭，旁边放着一台还冒着蒸汽的熨斗
scene: 洗衣房里蒸汽升起，她左手扶着衬衫，右手推着沉重的熨斗走过领口。The old gate is made of iron and has never rusted.
sceneCN: 这里 iron 是「铁」（第 1 个义项：那种金属），句意为这扇老门是铁做的，从来没有生锈。画面里的物件：熨斗、衬衫、蒸汽。

collocations.phrase: strike while the iron is hot

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「熨烫；要熨的衣物」
同以 iron 开头的形近词，义为「反讽」，词源不同
由本词加 ware 构成，义为「铁器」

senses.title: The metal
senses.definition: a hard grey metal used for tools, rails, and gates
senses.definitionCN: 一种坚硬灰暗的金属，用于工具、铁轨与大门
senses.example: The bridge was built with iron beams from the old mill.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥用了旧磨坊拆下来的铁梁。
senses.why: The metal sense is the oldest and stays attached to beams, rails, and gates.
senses.whyCN: 金属义最古老，至今仍与梁、轨、门连在一起。

senses.title: The smoothing tool
senses.definition: a flat heated tool used to press wrinkles out of cloth
senses.definitionCN: 一种扁平且加热的工具，用来压平布上的皱褶
senses.example: The iron was still hot when she put it down.
senses.exampleCN: 她放下熨斗时它还是烫的。
senses.why: The tool took the metal name because it was a block of iron heated over a fire.
senses.whyCN: 这个工具之所以借了金属的名字，因为它本是放在火上加热的铁块。

senses.title: Pressing clothes smooth
senses.definition: to press cloth with heat so that it lies flat
senses.definitionCN: 用热量压平布料
senses.example: He ironed his shirt five minutes before the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 面试前五分钟他才把衬衫熨好。
senses.why: The verb is simply the tool turned into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词义就是把工具名直接变成动作。

senses.title: Chains and firm will
senses.definition: metal restraints, or metaphorically a hard and unyielding quality
senses.definitionCN: 金属镣铐，或比喻坚硬不屈的性质
senses.example: They spoke of the iron discipline of the mountain rescue team.
senses.exampleCN: 他们谈起山地救援队那种铁一般的纪律。
senses.why: From chains to character, the hard metal became a figure for what will not bend.
senses.whyCN: 从镣铐到性格，这种硬金属成了「不肯弯」的象征。

intro.en: Iron is an old Germanic word; its distant origin is uncertain, though Celtic is a strong candidate.
intro.cn: iron 是个古老的日耳曼词，更远的来源不确定，凯尔特语是较有力的候选。

items.en: The word appears as isern or iren in early texts.
items.cn: 这个词在早期文献中写作 isern 或 iren。

items.en: Related forms include German Eisen and Old Saxon isarn.
items.cn: 同源形式包括德语 Eisen 与古撒克逊语 isarn。

items.en: The deeper root may come from a Celtic metal word, but it is disputed.
items.cn: 更深层词根可能来自凯尔特语的金属词，但仍有争议。

items.en: Middle English changed the -s- to -r-, giving iren.
items.cn: 中古英语把 -s- 变成 -r-，写作 iren。

items.en: Modern English settled on iron for both the metal and the tool.
items.cn: 现代英语把 iron 固定下来，兼指金属与熨斗。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the iron spelling; the near-meaning group holds words for metals and pressing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 iron 拼写；近义组收表示金属与压平动作的词。

entries.definition: Saying the opposite of what you mean.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「反讽」，拼写相近但词源不同。

entries.definition: The plural, or chains for a prisoner.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为复数，也可指镣铐。

entries.definition: The activity of pressing clothes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「熨烫」，同族词。

entries.definition: Iron hardened with carbon.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「钢」，铁与碳的合金。

entries.definition: To push down or flatten with force.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「压」，压平的动作。

entries.definition: To make a surface even.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「使平整」，结果导向。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie together the metal, the tool, and the act of pressing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把金属、工具和压平这个动作串起来。

normal.en: One word, one metal, one heavy tool.
normal.cn: 一个词，既是金属，也是那件沉工具。

normal.en: An iron is heavy because it is iron.
normal.cn: 熨斗沉，正是因为它就是铁。

normal.en: To iron is to press with that weight.
normal.cn: iron 作动词就是拿这份重量去压。

normal.en: German Eisen is a cousin from the same family.
normal.cn: 德语 Eisen 是同族的表亲。

normal.en: The -r- came late; early English said isern.
normal.cn: 那个 -r- 是后来才有，早先英语说 isern。

abstract.en: Iron is a metal that remembers the shape you give it.
abstract.cn: 铁是会记住你所给形状的金属。

abstract.en: An iron is iron made gentle by heat.
abstract.cn: 熨斗是被热软化过的铁。

abstract.en: Iron will is the metal kept uncooled.
abstract.cn: 铁一般的意志，是不肯冷却的金属。

examples.en: The locket is silver, but the chain is iron.
examples.cn: 坠子是银的，链子却是铁的。

examples.en: She ironed the curtains before hanging them again.
examples.cn: 她先把窗帘熨好再重新挂上。

examples.en: The prisoners wore irons on their ankles.
examples.cn: 囚犯脚踝上带着镣铐。

dict_mnemonic.text: iron 既是铁，也是拿铁做的熨斗，最后成了熨衣服

root: 古英语 isern / iren（日耳曼语词）→ 中古英语 iren → 现代英语 iron。同源有德语 Eisen；更深层来源可能来自凯尔特语，尚无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the metal, the smoothing tool, pressing clothes, and chains or an unyielding will.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：金属铁、熨斗、熨衣服，以及镣铐或钢铁般的意志。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey metal heavy enough to press cloth flat.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块沉得足以把布压平的灰色金属。

branches.en: THE BEAM: metal bent into bridges and gates.
branches.cn: 铁梁这条线：被弯成桥梁与大门的金属。

branches.en: THE TOOL: the same metal given a handle and heat.
branches.cn: 工具这条线：同一块金属加上把手和热。

branches.en: THE ACT: pressing cloth until wrinkles go.
branches.cn: 动作这条线：把布压到皱褶消失。

branches.en: THE STRENGTH: hardness is both material and metaphor.
branches.cn: 坚硬这条线：硬度既是材质也是比喻。

branches.en: THE HAND: the tool and the act are one idea.
branches.cn: 手这条线：工具和动作本是同一个意思。

intro.en: Iron has no prefix or suffix to cut off; it is a whole Germanic root whose origin is debated.
intro.cn: iron 没有可切分的前后缀，它是一个来源有争议的完整日耳曼词根。

latinIntro.en: There is no secure Latin source, so latinEntries stays empty; Latin ferrum "iron" is unrelated.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有可靠的拉丁语来源，所以 latinEntries 留空；拉丁语 ferrum「铁」并不同源。

items.example: It forms irons, also used for chains.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 irons，也用来指镣铐。

items.example: The compound joins iron to ware.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把 iron 与 ware 连起来。
另一个复合词，指一种行当。

items.example: It starts with the same letters but is unrelated in origin.
items.exampleCN: 开头字母相同，却不同源。

items.example: The earlier spelling shows the lost -s-.
items.exampleCN: 较早的写法显示那个消失的 -s-。

items.example: The compound keeps the metal image.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词保留了金属的意象。

definition_zh: 岛；岛屿；安全岛；孤立的群体
definition_en: a piece of land with water all around it, or anything that stands alone surrounded by something else
core_image: 一圈水把一块陆地围在中央，四周望不到岸
scene: 渡轮驶过一片平静的海面，远处出现一小块被水围住的绿色陆地。A single island appeared on the horizon before sunset.
sceneCN: 这里 island 是「岛屿」（第 1 个义项：四面环水的陆地），句意为日落前地平线上出现了一座孤岛。画面里的物件：渡轮、海面、地平线。

pos.zh: 名词：岛；岛屿；安全岛；孤立之地

derivatives.zh: 由 island 加 -er 构成，义为「岛民」
由古法语 islette 借入，是 island 的指小形式，义为「小岛」
与 island 同源的借词，义为「小岛」，多用于地名

senses.title: Land surrounded by water
senses.definition: a piece of land smaller than a continent, completely surrounded by water
senses.definitionCN: 比大陆小、四面被水包围的陆地
senses.example: The island is reachable only by boat.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛只能坐船到达。
senses.why: The geographic sense is the central one and the only one the Old English word named.
senses.whyCN: 地理义是核心，也是古英语时期这个词唯一指的意思。

senses.title: A raised area in a road
senses.definition: a raised or marked area in the middle of a road where pedestrians can wait
senses.definitionCN: 马路中间供行人等候的高起或划线区域
senses.example: Wait on the traffic island until the light turns green.
senses.exampleCN: 在交通岛上等绿灯再走。
senses.why: A safety island is a patch of ground cut off by streams of traffic, exactly like land in water.
senses.whyCN: 安全岛是被车流围住的一小块地，和水中陆地是同一个画面。

senses.title: A detached group
senses.definition: a group of people or things standing apart from everything around them
senses.definitionCN: 与周围完全隔开的一群人或物
senses.example: The village became an island of old customs in a modern city.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子成了现代城市里一座旧习俗的孤岛。
senses.why: The metaphor transfers surrounding water to surrounding difference, leaving the group alone.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把四周的水换成四周的差异，于是这群人显得孤立。

senses.title: A kitchen unit standing alone
senses.definition: a counter or work surface standing free in the middle of a kitchen
senses.definitionCN: 立在厨房中央、四周不与墙相连的操作台
senses.example: The new kitchen has a marble island for chopping.
senses.exampleCN: 新厨房有一个大理石岛台用来切菜。
senses.why: The counter is surrounded by open floor instead of water, but it still stands alone.
senses.whyCN: 岛台被空出来的地面而不是水围着，但仍然是孤零零立着的。

senses.title: An isolated rise of tissue
senses.definition: a small separate patch of cells or tissue of one kind inside another kind
senses.definitionCN: 一种组织中被另一类组织包围的小块区域
senses.example: The scan showed a tiny island of healthy cells.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描显示有一小片健康的细胞岛。
senses.why: Medical usage keeps the shape of one kind of material surrounded by a different one.
senses.whyCN: 医学用法保留了「一种物质被另一种包围」的形状。

intro.en: Island is an English word whose modern spelling was reshaped by confusion with Latin insula; the s is silent because of that error.
intro.cn: island 是英语本土词，现代拼写受拉丁语 insula 的误认影响而改写，s 不发音正来自这场误会。

items.en: The native word was igland, from ieg, "island", and land.
items.cn: 本土形式是 igland，由 ieg「岛」与 land 构成。

items.en: ieg itself could also mean a piece of low ground near water.
items.cn: ieg 本身也可指水边的一片低地。

items.en: The form shifted toward iland, and the s was later inserted by false association.
items.cn: 中古英语时期写作 iland，后来因错误联想被插入了 s。

items.en: Latin insula, "island", supplied the model for adding that s.
items.cn: 拉丁语 insula「岛」提供了加这个 s 的模型。

items.en: The spelling island was fixed in print, while the s stayed silent.
items.cn: island 的拼写在印刷中固定下来，而 s 始终不发音。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words with the silent s or the isl- shape; the near-meaning group holds land forms and water terms.
note.cn: 形近组收含不发音 s 或 isl- 形状的词；近义组收地貌与水域相关词。

entries.definition: A small island, now mostly in names.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「小岛」，与 island 同源的借词。

entries.definition: A very small island.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「小岛」，是 isle 的指小形式。

entries.definition: The plural of isle, with the same silent s.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「岛屿（复数）」，与 isle 一起显示不发音的 s，拼写相近。

entries.definition: Land almost surrounded by water but joined to the mainland.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「半岛」，三面是水一面连陆。

entries.definition: A group of islands.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「群岛」，是许多岛的组合。

entries.definition: A ridge of rock or coral near the water surface.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「礁」，不是陆地而是水下的隆起。

normalIntro.en: These hooks connect the native igland, the false Latin s, and the island images of roads and kitchens.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把本土词 igland、误加的拉丁 s，以及马路与厨房里的岛连在一起。

normal.en: Old English igland combined ieg and land.
normal.cn: 古英语 igland 由 ieg 与 land 组合而成。

normal.en: The s in island is silent because it was wrongly inserted.
normal.cn: island 里的 s 因误加而不发音。

normal.en: Latin insula named a house for several families in Rome.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 insula 在罗马指一栋住多户的房子。

normal.en: An islander lives on an island.
normal.cn: islander 就是住在岛上的人。

normal.en: A traffic island stands between two lanes.
normal.cn: 交通岛立在两条车道之间。

abstract.en: An island is land that water has agreed to surround.
abstract.cn: 岛是水同意包围起来的一块地。

abstract.en: Every safe island is a pause in a moving stream.
abstract.cn: 每一个安全岛都是车流里的一次停顿。

abstract.en: A kitchen island is a place for work in the middle of open floor.
abstract.cn: 厨房岛台是空地上的一个工作点。

examples.en: The island has no cars and only one shop.
examples.cn: 这座岛没有汽车，只有一家店。

examples.en: Children wait on the traffic island before crossing.
examples.cn: 孩子们在交通岛上等候过马路。

examples.en: Her office was an island of quiet in a noisy building.
examples.cn: 她的办公室在吵闹的大楼里是一片安静的孤岛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱拦岛」—— 海把这块地爱拦在怀里，不让它离开

root: 古英语 ieg「岛；水边低地」+ land → igland → iland → island（受拉丁 insula 影响插入不发音的 s）。同族有 isle、islet、islander。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: land in water, a road island, a detached group, a kitchen island, and a patch of tissue.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：水中陆地、交通岛、孤立的群体、厨房岛台，以及组织孤岛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a patch of land held in a ring of water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块被水圈住的陆地。

branches.en: THE HORIZON: green land seen from a ferry.
branches.cn: 地平线这条线：从渡轮上望见的绿陆地。

branches.en: THE ROAD: a raised patch between lanes.
branches.cn: 马路这条线：车道之间的高起小块。

branches.en: THE VILLAGE: old customs kept apart from a city.
branches.cn: 村子这条线：与城市隔开的旧习俗。

branches.en: THE KITCHEN: a counter standing in open floor.
branches.cn: 厨房这条线：立在空地里的操作台。

branches.en: THE SCAN: a separate patch of cells.
branches.cn: 扫描这条线：另成一块的细胞。

intro.en: Island is a compound of two Old English elements; English endings do the rest.
intro.cn: island 由两个古英语成分复合而成，其余由英语词尾完成。

latinIntro.en: Latin insula influenced only the spelling, not the origin, yet its relatives are worth listing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 insula 只影响了拼写而非来源，但它的同族词值得列出。

items.example: The stem of insular and isolate.
items.exampleCN: insular 与 isolate 的词干。

items.example: It forms island life and island nation.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 island life 与 island nation。

definition_zh: 问题；议题；（报刊的）期号；（证券的）发行；发出；流出
definition_en: a subject people discuss or worry about, one set of printed copies, or the act of officially giving or sending something out
core_image: 水从闸门缝里涌出来，人群围住它讨论该怎么办
scene: 会议室的白板上写满条目，争论渐渐集中到同一行字上。Everyone agreed the main issue was money.
sceneCN: 这里 issue 是「问题、议题」（第 1 个义项：需要讨论或解决的事），句意为大家都认为主要问题在于钱。画面里的物件：白板、条目、会议桌。

pos.zh: 名词：问题；议题；期号；发行

derivatives.zh: 由 issue 加 -ance 构成，义为「发行；签发」
由 issue 加 -er 构成，义为「发行人」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「已发行的；已签发的」

senses.title: A subject to discuss
senses.definition: an important topic that people are discussing or arguing about
senses.definitionCN: 人们正在讨论或争论的重要话题
senses.example: Housing is the biggest issue in this election.
senses.exampleCN: 住房是这次选举中最大的问题。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a going out or a flowing forth, and a disputed question is what flows out into public talk.
senses.whyCN: 最早的意思有「流出」，而值得争论的问题正是从人群里流出来的话题。

senses.title: A problem to solve
senses.definition: a difficulty or problem that needs to be dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 需要处理的困难或麻烦
senses.example: We have an issue with the water supply.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的供水出了问题。
senses.why: A problem is a question that has begun to leak, so the outflow image turns into trouble.
senses.whyCN: 麻烦就是开始漏水的那个问题，流出的画面变成了故障。

senses.title: One set of printed copies
senses.definition: a single set of a newspaper or magazine published at one time
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或杂志一次出版的全部内容
senses.example: The May issue has a long article on bees.
senses.exampleCN: 五月那一期有一篇关于蜜蜂的长文。
senses.why: Each copy flows out from the press on one day, so the noun names one release.
senses.whyCN: 每一批印品在一天里从印刷机流出，于是这个名词指一次发行。

senses.title: To give out officially
senses.definition: to officially give something such as a document, ticket, or warning to people
senses.definitionCN: 正式把文件、票据或警告等交给别人
senses.example: The office issued new passes to all visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室向所有访客发出了新通行证。
senses.why: Issuing sends something out from an authority, exactly the going-out of the Latin source.
senses.whyCN: 签发是权威把东西送出去，正是词源里「向外走」的意思。

senses.title: To flow out
senses.definition: to come or flow out from a place or an opening
senses.definitionCN: 从某处、某开口流出来
senses.example: Water issued from a crack in the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 水从墙上的裂缝里流出。
senses.why: This is the oldest bodily sense, kept in modern technical writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的具体义，保留在现代技术性描述里。

senses.title: To result from
senses.definition: to come or result from a particular cause or source
senses.definitionCN: 由某个原因或来源产生
senses.example: Her doubts issue from an earlier failure.
senses.exampleCN: 她的疑虑源自更早的一次失败。
senses.why: Something that comes out of a source is the same movement as water out of a gap.
senses.whyCN: 从来源出来，与从缺口出水是同一种移动。

intro.en: Issue comes from Latin exire, "to go out", through its past participle exitus, "a going out".
intro.cn: issue 来自拉丁语 exire「出去」，经其过去分词 exitus「出去、出口」进入古法语。

items.en: exire meant to go out, from ex, out, and ire, to go.
items.cn: exire 意为出去，由 ex「向外」与 ire「走」组成。

items.en: exitus meant a going out, an end, or an outlet.
items.cn: exitus 意为出去、结果或出口。

items.en: Old French issue named an outlet, a way out, or a result.
items.cn: 古法语 issue 指出口、出路或结果。

items.en: English adopted issue for an exit and later for something sent out.
items.cn: 英语先以 issue 表示出口，后来表示送出的东西。

items.en: Printing made issue mean one release of a periodical, and the debate sense followed.
items.cn: 印刷出版让 issue 指一期刊物，讨论话题的义项随之出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the exit or issu- shape; the near-meaning group holds words for topics, problems, and sending out.
note.cn: 形近组共用 exit、issu- 形状；近义组收表示议题、问题与发出的词。

entries.definition: A way out or the act of leaving.
entries.definitionCN: 与 issue 同为拉丁 exire 的后代，义为「出口；离开」。

entries.definition: The act of officially issuing something.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ance 构成，义为「发行；签发」。

entries.definition: The material of which body parts are made.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「组织」，拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: The subject of a talk or text.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「主题」，偏中性的讨论对象。

entries.definition: A difficulty that needs solving.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「难题」，比 issue 更直接。

entries.definition: To give things out to many people.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「分发」，与 issue 的发出义相近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from the Latin going-out verb to magazines, tickets, and arguments.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从拉丁语「出去」的动词走到杂志、票据与争论。

normal.en: Latin exire means to go out.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 exire 意为出去。

normal.en: exitus means a going out or an outlet.
normal.cn: exitus 意为出去或出口。

normal.en: An issue of a magazine goes out on one day.
normal.cn: 一期杂志在一天里发行出去。

normal.en: To issue a ticket is to hand it out officially.
normal.cn: issue a ticket 就是正式发出票据。

normal.en: The main issue is what everyone argues about.
normal.cn: main issue 就是大家都在争的那件事。

abstract.en: An issue is a subject that leaks out of a group.
abstract.cn: 议题是从人群里漏出来的话题。

abstract.en: A problem is an issue with its lid off.
abstract.cn: 麻烦是揭了盖子的议题。

abstract.en: What issues from a source was inside it before.
abstract.cn: 从来源流出的东西，原本就在里面。

examples.en: Privacy is a serious issue for many users.
examples.cn: 隐私对许多用户来说是严重的问题。

examples.en: The bank will issue a new card next week.
examples.cn: 银行下周会发行一张新卡。

examples.en: Smoke issued from the vents on the roof.
examples.cn: 烟从屋顶的通风口里冒出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一休」—— 一休思考的正是那个大问题

root: 拉丁语 exire「出去」（ex 向外 + ire 走）→ exitus「出去；出口」→ 古法语 issue → 英语 issue。同族有 exit、issuance、issuer。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses: a topic under discussion, a difficulty, one release of a periodical, official giving out, flowing out, and resulting from.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项：讨论的议题、麻烦、一期刊物、正式发出、流出，以及出自某来源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water slipping out of a gate while a crowd argues about it.
core.cn: 核心意象：水从闸门缝里涌出，人群围着它争论。

branches.en: THE ELECTION: one topic everyone keeps returning to.
branches.cn: 选举这条线：人人反复回到的那个话题。

branches.en: THE PIPE: a leak that has become trouble.
branches.cn: 水管这条线：漏成了麻烦。

branches.en: THE BEES: one month of a magazine leaving the press.
branches.cn: 蜜蜂这条线：从印刷机出来的一期杂志。

branches.en: THE PASS: a document handed out at a desk.
branches.cn: 通行证这条线：在窗口发出去的文件。

branches.en: THE CRACK: water out of a gap, doubt out of a failure.
branches.cn: 裂缝这条线：水从缺口出，疑虑从失败出。

intro.en: Issue is a French reshaping of the Latin noun exitus; only English endings are later additions.
intro.cn: issue 是古法语对拉丁名词 exitus 的改写，后面加的英语词尾是后来才有的。

latinIntro.en: The Latin relatives all turn on ex-, out, and ire, to go.
latinIntro.cn: 这些拉丁同族词都围绕 ex-「向外」与 ire「走」。

items.example: Combined with ire it forms exire.
items.exampleCN: 与 ire 结合构成 exire。

items.example: The base verb of the family.

items.exampleCN: 法语写作 issue，而非 exite。

items.example: It forms issue date and issue number.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 issue date 与 issue number。

definition_zh: 它；（指时间、天气、距离等）；（作形式主语或形式宾语）；重要的人
definition_en: the thing or animal already mentioned, used as a pronoun for things and for time, weather, and distance
core_image: 手指一点，点中桌上一只说不上名字的东西
scene: 桌上放着一个旧盒子，谁都没打开过。Nobody knows what is inside it.
sceneCN: 这里 it 是「它」（第 1 个义项：指代上文提到的物品），句意为没人知道它里面是什么。画面里的物件：旧盒子、桌面。

pos.zh: 名词：重要的人或事；时髦

derivatives.zh: 由 it 加 s 构成，义为「它的」，作定语
由 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」

senses.title: The thing already mentioned
senses.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, or idea that has already been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 用来指上文已经提到的物品、动物或想法
senses.example: I found the key and put it in my pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 我找到钥匙，把它放进口袋。
senses.why: The third person pronoun for things is the oldest and simplest use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 指物的第三人称代词是这个词最古老也最简单的用法。

senses.title: Time, weather, and distance
senses.definition: used as an empty subject when talking about time, weather, temperature, or distance
senses.definitionCN: 谈论时间、天气、温度或距离时作没有实际含义的主语
senses.example: It is already dark outside.
senses.exampleCN: 外面已经黑了。
senses.why: English needs a subject in every sentence, so an empty it holds the place of time and weather.
senses.whyCN: 英语每句都要有主语，于是空主语的 it 占住了时间与天气的位置。

senses.title: A formal subject or object
senses.definition: used as a placeholder subject or object before the real clause or infinitive
senses.definitionCN: 在真正的主语或宾语从句、不定式前占位的虚词
senses.example: It is hard to say goodbye.
senses.exampleCN: 说再见是件难事。
senses.why: The real subject is the clause at the end, and it simply marks the seat until it arrives.
senses.whyCN: 真正的主语在后面那个从句，it 只是先占座，等它到来。

senses.title: A situation in general
senses.definition: used to refer to a situation or state of affairs already understood
senses.definitionCN: 用来指已经明了的情况或局面
senses.example: It has been like this for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这种情况已经持续多年了。
senses.why: A whole situation can be treated as one thing, so the pronoun covers more than a single object.
senses.whyCN: 整个局面可以当成一个东西看，于是这个代词涵盖的不止一件物体。

senses.title: A person of importance
senses.definition: used in informal speech for a person who is thought to be important or fashionable
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来指被认为重要或时髦的人
senses.example: She thinks she is it after the promotion.
senses.exampleCN: 升职之后她觉得自己很了不起。
senses.why: Calling a person it says they are the one, the single notable thing in view.
senses.whyCN: 把一个人称作 it，等于说他们就是那个唯一显眼的存在。

senses.title: A game of tag
senses.definition: used as the name of the children's chasing game, and for the player who must chase
senses.definitionCN: 用作儿童追逐游戏的名称，也指负责追的人
senses.example: The children played it in the playground until dark.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在操场上玩抓人游戏直到天黑。
senses.why: The game name comes from the bare pronoun, the chased one simply being it.
senses.whyCN: 游戏名直接来自这个代词，被追的那个人就是「它」。

intro.en: It is the native English third person pronoun for things, recorded from Old English hit.
intro.cn: it 是英语本土的第三人称指物代词，古英语时期写作 hit。

items.en: The form was hit, with the h pronounced.
items.cn: 古英语形式是 hit，开头的 h 要发音。

items.en: Germanic relatives include Dutch het and German es.
items.cn: 日耳曼亲属有荷兰语 het 与德语 es。

items.en: The h was lost in unstressed speech, leaving it.
items.cn: 中古英语中 h 在弱读时脱落，剩下 it。

items.en: It became the fixed pronoun for things and animals.
items.cn: it 固定为指物与动物的代词。

items.en: Empty uses for time, weather, and formal subjects spread in later prose.
items.cn: 指时间天气与作形式主语的用法在近代散文中普及。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short it- shape; the near-meaning group holds the other pronouns of reference.
note.cn: 形近组都是 it 开头的短词形；近义组收其余指代代词。

entries.definition: Belonging to it.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 s 构成，义为「它的」，同族代词。

entries.definition: The same thing, emphatically.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 self 构成，义为「它自己」。

entries.definition: A single thing on a list.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「条目」，拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: The thing here near the speaker.
entries.definitionCN: 指示代词义为「这个」，指近处。

entries.definition: The thing further from the speaker.
entries.definitionCN: 指示代词义为「那个」，指远处。

entries.definition: The things or people already mentioned, as a plural.
entries.definitionCN: 代词义为「它们、他们」，是 it 的复数。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from the Old English hit to the empty it of weather and formal subjects.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从古英语 hit 走到天气与形式主语里的空 it。

normal.en: Old English hit lost its h to become it.
normal.cn: 古英语 hit 掉了 h 变成 it。

normal.en: Its and itself are built from it.
normal.cn: its 与 itself 都由 it 构成。

normal.en: Make it means to succeed or to arrive in time.
normal.cn: make it 意为成功或及时赶到。

normal.en: It is the empty subject of weather sentences.
normal.cn: it 是天气句里的空主语。

normal.en: German es and Dutch het are cousins.
normal.cn: 德语 es 与荷兰语 het 是它的亲属。

abstract.en: It is a finger pointing at the thing already named.
abstract.cn: it 是指向已说出那件东西的手指。

abstract.en: An empty it keeps the seat warm for a long clause.
abstract.cn: 空主语的 it 替长从句先把座位暖着。

abstract.en: In tag, whoever is it must run.
abstract.cn: 在抓人游戏里，被称作 it 的人就得跑。

examples.en: The box is heavy, so lift it carefully.
examples.cn: 这个箱子很重，搬的时候小心点。

examples.en: It is raining again this afternoon.
examples.cn: 今天下午又下雨了。

examples.en: It is not easy to learn a new language.
examples.cn: 学一门新语言并不容易。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一特」—— 手指一伸，特指桌上那一件东西

root: 古英语 hit（第三人称指物代词，h 发音）→ 中古英语脱落 h → 现代英语 it。同族有 its、itself。

sensesIntro.en: Six uses: the thing mentioned, empty subject for time and weather, formal subject or object, a general situation, an important person, and the game of tag.
sensesIntro.cn: 六种用法：指已提到的物品、时间天气的空主语、形式主语或宾语、泛指情况、重要人物，以及抓人游戏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing at one unnamed thing on the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指点住桌上那件说不清名字的东西。

branches.en: THE KEY: one item already named in the sentence.
branches.cn: 钥匙这条线：句子里已经点过的物件。

branches.en: THE WEATHER: an empty seat before the real subject.
branches.cn: 天气这条线：真主语到来前的空座。

branches.en: THE YEARS: one long situation treated as a single thing.
branches.cn: 年月这条线：把长局面当成一件事。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a person who thinks she is the one.
branches.cn: 办公室这条线：自认独一无二的人。

branches.en: THE PLAYGROUND: the child who must chase.
branches.cn: 操场这条线：必须去追人的那个孩子。

intro.en: It is a bare Germanic pronoun; the longer forms are made with English pieces.
intro.cn: it 是一个单独的日耳曼语代词，长形式由英语成分构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so latinEntries is empty; the Latin pronoun for it is listed only for contrast in grammar.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，所以 latinEntries 留空，只在语法上作对照。

items.example: The h was dropped in Middle English.
It has no apostrophe in its.
It reveals nothing in it rains.
items.exampleCN: it rains 里的 it 不指任何东西。

definition_zh: 项目；条款；一件物品；一条新闻
definition_en: a single thing in a list, group, or set, or one piece of news in a report
core_image: 清单上一行一行的小格子，每格只放一件东西
scene: 超市的收银台上，收银员把篮子里的东西一件件拿出来扫描。Each item was scanned and bagged in seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 item 是「一件物品」（第 1 个义项：清单里单列的一样东西），句意为每件物品几秒内就扫完装袋。画面里的物件：收银台、购物篮、扫描枪。

pos.zh: 名词：项目；条款；一件物品；一条新闻

derivatives.zh: 由 item 加 -ize 构成，义为「逐项列出」
由 itemize 加 -ation 构成，义为「逐项列明」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「逐项列出的」

senses.title: One thing in a set
senses.definition: a single object among a number of similar things, especially in a shop or a set
senses.definitionCN: 一批同类东西中的单独一件，常用于商店或成套物品
senses.example: Every item in the box was checked twice.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子里的每件物品都查了两遍。
senses.why: The word began as a single entry in a list, and a thing in a shop is one such entry.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指清单上的单独一条，商店里的那件东西正是这样一条。

senses.title: A point on a list
senses.definition: one point or entry in a list, agenda, or order of business
senses.definitionCN: 清单、议程或议事程序中的一条
senses.example: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 议程上的第一项是预算。
senses.why: The list sense is the oldest one, and each numbered line is still an item.
senses.whyCN: 清单义最古老，每一条编号的行仍然叫 item。

senses.title: A clause in a document
senses.definition: one separate article or clause in a contract, law, or set of rules
senses.definitionCN: 合同、法律或规章中单独的一条
senses.example: Item three of the contract sets the payment date.
senses.exampleCN: 合同第三条规定了付款日期。
senses.why: A legal clause is a list entry written by lawyers, so the same word fits.
senses.whyCN: 法律条款是律师写下的清单条目，于是同一个词也适用。

senses.title: One piece of news
senses.definition: a short single report in a newspaper, broadcast, or news feed
senses.definitionCN: 报纸、广播或信息流中单独的一条报道
senses.example: A short news item mentioned the bridge closure.
senses.exampleCN: 一条短新闻提到了那座桥封闭的消息。
senses.why: A news page is a list of reports, and each report is one item on it.
senses.whyCN: 新闻版面就是一串报道，每篇都是上面的一条。

senses.title: Two people as a couple
senses.definition: used in old-fashioned or humorous speech for two people known to be a couple
senses.definitionCN: 旧式或玩笑说法，指大家知道的一对情侣
senses.example: They are an item again after the summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天过后他们又成了一对。
senses.why: A couple becomes a single entry in gossip, so two people are listed as one thing.
senses.whyCN: 一对情侣在闲谈里变成一个条目，于是两个人被当成一样东西列出来。

intro.en: Item is the Latin word item, meaning "likewise, in the same way", used to begin each separate entry in a list.
intro.cn: item 就是拉丁语 item「同样地」，原本用在清单每一条的开头，后来被当成那一条本身。

items.en: item was an adverb meaning likewise or also.
items.cn: item 是副词，意为同样地、也。

items.en: In lists and accounts each line began with item, so the word marked one entry.
items.cn: 在清单和账簿里每一行都以 item 开头，于是这个词标记一条记录。

items.en: Old French took item as a noun for an entry in a list.
items.cn: 古法语把 item 用作名词，指清单里的一条。

items.en: English borrowed it for a statement in an account or inventory.
items.cn: 英语借来指账目或清册中的一项。

items.en: The meaning widened from list entry to any single thing.
items.cn: 词义从清单条目扩展到任何单独的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ite-/item- shape; the near-meaning group holds words for single things and list entries.
note.cn: 形近组共用 ite-、item- 形状；近义组收表示单件物品与清单条目的词。

entries.definition: To list things one by one.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ize 构成，义为「逐项列出」，同族动词。

entries.definition: The plural of item.
entries.definitionCN: 复数形式，义为「多个项目」，同族。

entries.definition: The pronoun for a thing already named.
entries.definitionCN: 代词义为「它」，拼写只是开头相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: A written piece, or one clause of a document.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「文章；条款」，与 item 的条款义重叠。

entries.definition: A physical thing that can be seen and touched.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「物品」，只指实物。

entries.definition: One record written in a list or book.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「条目」，强调写下来的记录。

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from the Latin adverb item to the supermarket counter and the agenda.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从拉丁语副词 item 走到超市收银台与会议议程。

normal.en: Latin item meant likewise or also.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 item 意为同样地、也。

normal.en: Each line of an old list began with item.
normal.cn: 旧清单的每一行都以 item 开头。

normal.en: Itemize means to put things into items.
normal.cn: itemize 就是把东西逐项列出来。

normal.en: A news item is one report in a bulletin.
normal.cn: news item 就是简报里的一条报道。

normal.en: Item by item means one thing at a time.
normal.cn: item by item 意为一项一项地。

abstract.en: An item is a box that holds exactly one thing.
abstract.cn: item 是只装一样东西的小格子。

abstract.en: A list is a row of boxes, each called an item.
abstract.cn: 清单就是一排格子，每个格子叫一项。

abstract.en: Two people who are an item share one box.
abstract.cn: 成为一对的两个人共用一个格子。

examples.en: Please list each item on a separate line.
examples.cn: 请把每一项分行列出。

examples.en: The last item on the agenda was the new office.
examples.cn: 议程最后一项是新办公室。

examples.en: She counted every item in the delivery.
examples.cn: 她清点了这批货里的每一件物品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一件」—— 清单上就一件一件地数

root: 拉丁语副词 item「同样地；也」→ 清单每行开头的标志 → 古法语 item「一条」→ 英语 item「项目；一件」。同族有 itemize、itemization。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: one object in a set, a point on a list, a legal clause, one piece of news, and a couple.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：成套物品中的一件、清单上的一项、法律条款、一条新闻，以及一对情侣。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a column of small boxes, one thing in each.
core.cn: 核心意象：一列小格子，每格只放一样东西。

branches.en: THE COUNTER: each thing scanned once.
branches.cn: 收银台这条线：每样东西各扫一次。

branches.en: THE AGENDA: numbered points in order.
branches.cn: 议程这条线：按顺序编号的事项。

branches.en: THE CONTRACT: one clause with a number.
branches.cn: 合同这条线：带编号的那一条。

branches.en: THE BULLETIN: a single short report.
branches.cn: 简报这条线：单独的一条短报道。

branches.en: THE GOSSIP: two names written as one entry.
branches.cn: 闲谈这条线：两个名字写成一个条目。

intro.en: Item is a borrowed Latin word; English adds only -ize and noun endings.
intro.cn: item 是借来的拉丁词，英语只在后面加 -ize 与名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin relatives are forms of the same adverb and its noun use.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同族词就是这个副词及其名词用法的形式。

items.example: The mark at the start of each line.
Readers took the marker for the entry itself.
items.exampleCN: 读者把这个标记当成了条目本身。

items.example: It forms itemal in older legal writing.
items.exampleCN: 旧法律文本里构成 itemal。

items.example: It forms item number and item price.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 item number 与 item price。

latinEntries.meaning: the head of a new entry

definition_zh: 它的；其
definition_en: belonging to or connected with a thing or animal that has already been mentioned
core_image: 手指从别的东西移回那只盒子，示意盒盖是它的
scene: 客栈门外，客人看了看墙上的招牌和招牌下面那扇半开的门。The old inn has kept its wooden sign for a century.
sceneCN: 这里 its 是「它的」（第 1 个义项：指属于前面提到的事物），句意为这家老客栈一个世纪来一直保留着它那块木招牌。画面里的物件：招牌、半开的门、石墙。

derivatives.zh: its 的基础代词，义为「它」
由 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」

senses.title: Belonging to a thing
senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, animal, or idea already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 属于上文提到的物品、动物或想法
senses.example: The company changed its name last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司去年改了名字。
senses.why: Its is simply it plus a possessive ending, used before a noun.
senses.whyCN: its 就是 it 加所有格词尾，用在名词前。

senses.title: Belonging to an animal
senses.definition: belonging to an animal whose sex is unknown or not important
senses.definitionCN: 属于一只性别不明或不重要的动物
senses.example: The dog wagged its tail when the door opened.
senses.exampleCN: 门一开，那只狗就摇起了尾巴。
senses.why: English avoids he or she for animals by default, so its covers them all.
senses.whyCN: 英语默认不用 he 或 she 指动物，于是 its 把动物都涵盖了。

senses.title: Belonging to a baby
senses.definition: used for a baby or small child before the sex is known in the sentence
senses.definitionCN: 在句子里尚未指明性别时用来指婴儿或幼儿
senses.example: The baby dropped its toy and began to cry.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿把玩具掉了，开始哭起来。
senses.why: The same gap that hides an animal's sex also hides a baby's, so its fills in.
senses.whyCN: 藏在动物身上的性别空白也同样出现在婴儿身上，于是用 its 填补。

senses.title: A part of a whole
senses.definition: used for a part, member, or feature of an organisation, place, or system
senses.definitionCN: 指机构、地方或系统的组成部分、成员或特征
senses.example: The city is proud of its bridges.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市为它的桥梁感到自豪。
senses.why: An organisation is treated as one thing, and its parts belong to that thing.
senses.whyCN: 机构被当成一个整体，它的各个部分就属于这个整体。

senses.title: An abstract owner
senses.definition: used for something that belongs to an idea, quality, or event mentioned earlier
senses.definitionCN: 指属于前面提到的想法、性质或事件的东西
senses.example: The plan failed because of its cost.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划因成本而失败。
senses.why: Abstract nouns take the same possessive, since grammar does not ask whether the owner is solid.
senses.whyCN: 抽象名词用同一个所有格，因为语法不问拥有者是否摸得着。

intro.en: Its is a form made inside English from it plus a possessive ending; it has no separate ancient source.
intro.cn: its 是英语内部用 it 加所有格词尾造出的形式，没有独立的古老词源。

items.en: The pronoun appeared as hit, and its older possessive was his.
items.cn: 当时的代词是 hit，旧有的所有格用的是 his。

items.en: The h was lost, and the form it spread in ordinary speech.
items.cn: 中古英语丢了 h，it 在口语中普及。

items.en: Its appeared in writing in the sixteenth century as a new possessive.
items.cn: its 在十六世纪作为新的所有格出现在书面语中。

items.en: Early writers avoided its, and the Authorised Version of the Bible has none of it.
items.cn: 早期作者回避 its，钦定本圣经里一次也没用。

items.en: The apostrophe was never added, so its differs from it's on purpose.
items.cn: 词里始终不加撇号，所以 its 与 it's 是有意区分的。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on it plus an ending; the near-meaning group holds other possessives.
note.cn: 形近组都由 it 加词尾构成；近义组收其他所有格代词。

entries.definition: The short form of it is or it has.
entries.definitionCN: 缩写形式，意为「它是」或「它有」，与 its 同音但多撇号。

entries.definition: The same thing, referred to reflexively.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词根 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」。

entries.definition: The base pronoun for a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 基础代词，义为「它」，its 由它加词尾而来。

entries.definition: Belonging to a male person or animal.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格代词，义为「他的」，旧英语也用它指 it。

entries.definition: Belonging to several people or things.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格代词，义为「它们的」，用于复数。

entries.definition: Belonging to which person or thing.
entries.definitionCN: 疑问与关系所有格，义为「谁的」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks separate its from it's and place the form in the story of hit and his.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把 its 与 it's 分开，并把这一形式放回 hit 与 his 的历史里。

normal.en: Its is it plus a possessive ending, with no apostrophe.
normal.cn: its 是 it 加所有格词尾，不带撇号。

normal.en: It's always means it is or it has.
normal.cn: it's 永远表示它是或它有。

normal.en: Old English used his even for things.
normal.cn: 古英语连指物都用 his。

normal.en: Its first appeared in print in the sixteenth century.
normal.cn: its 在十六世纪才出现在印刷品里。

normal.en: Its own stresses that the owner is the thing itself.
normal.cn: its own 强调拥有者正是那件东西本身。

abstract.en: Its points back at the last thing in the sentence and says, mine.
abstract.cn: its 回指句子里最后那件东西，说声「我的」。

abstract.en: No apostrophe, because its is not a shortened sentence.
abstract.cn: 不加撇号，因为 its 不是句子的缩写。

abstract.en: An animal keeps its tail with the same little word.
abstract.cn: 动物也用这个小词保住它的尾巴。

examples.en: The film lost its charm after the first hour.
examples.cn: 这部影片在第一个小时后失去了魅力。

examples.en: The cat licked its paw and went back to sleep.
examples.cn: 猫舔了舔爪子又睡回去。

examples.en: The school celebrated its hundredth year.
examples.cn: 这所学校庆祝了它的第一百个年头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一件寺」—— 一座庙，说的是它自己那件东西

root: 古英语 hit（指物代词，旧所有格为 his）→ 中古英语脱 h 成 it → 十六世纪英语加 -s 造出 its。同族有 it、itself。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses: belonging to a thing, an animal, a baby, an organisation, or an abstract idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 五种用法：属于物品、动物、婴儿、机构，或抽象事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger moving from another thing back to the box, claiming it.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指从别处移回那只盒子，宣布它归自己。

branches.en: THE COMPANY: one name changed, one owner.
branches.cn: 公司这条线：改掉名字的是它自己。

branches.en: THE DOG: a tail that belongs to no named sex.
branches.cn: 狗这条线：一条不属于任何性别的尾巴。

branches.en: THE BABY: a toy dropped before the sex matters.
branches.cn: 婴儿这条线：性别未明时掉下的玩具。

branches.en: THE CITY: bridges that belong to a whole.
branches.cn: 城市这条线：属于整体的那些桥。

branches.en: THE PLAN: a cost that belongs to an idea.
branches.cn: 计划这条线：属于一个想法的成本。

intro.en: Its is a short English form; the ending is the only piece added to it.
intro.cn: its 是一个简短的英语形式，唯一的构件是加在 it 后面的词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for its, so latinEntries is empty.
latinIntro.cn: its 没有拉丁语来源，因此 latinEntries 留空。

items.exampleCN: 它把 it 变成 its。

items.example: It forms itself, not its self.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 itself，而非分开写。

items.example: It belongs to it's, a contraction.
items.exampleCN: 它属于缩写 it's，与本词不同。

definition_zh: 它自己；自身；（用于强调）本身
definition_en: used to show that a thing is the same one already mentioned, or to give emphasis to that thing
core_image: 镜子立在一件物体前，镜内镜外是同一样东西
scene: 孩子第一次看到镜中的自己，伸手去摸，镜子发出轻轻的一声响。The old machine started itself after the power came back.
sceneCN: 这里 itself 是「它自己」（第 1 个义项：指同一个事物，动作回到自身），句意为来电后那台旧机器自己启动了。画面里的物件：镜子、控制面板、指示灯。

pos.zh: 代词：它自己；自身；（加强语气）本身

derivatives.zh: itself 的基础代词，义为「它」
由 it 加 s 构成，义为「它的」
itself 的组成部分，义为「自身」

senses.title: The same thing acts
senses.definition: used when the thing already mentioned is the one doing or receiving the action
senses.definitionCN: 当已提到的事物本身是动作的发出者或承受者时使用
senses.example: The door closed itself in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 门被风吹得自己关上了。
senses.why: Self turns the pronoun back on its own subject, so the actor and the object are one.
senses.whyCN: self 把代词折回到主语身上，于是施动者和受动者是同一个。

senses.title: Emphasis on a thing
senses.definition: used to stress that this thing, and not another, is meant
senses.definitionCN: 强调所指正是这件东西而不是别的
senses.example: The building itself is old, but the inside is new.
senses.exampleCN: 这座建筑本身很旧，里面却是新的。
senses.why: Emphatic use points at the thing bare, as if removing everything around it.
senses.whyCN: 强调用法直指那件东西本身，仿佛把周围都去掉了。

senses.title: Acting without help
senses.definition: used with by to show that nobody else was involved
senses.definitionCN: 与 by 连用，表示没有别人参与
senses.example: The child can dress itself now.
senses.exampleCN: 这孩子现在能自己穿衣服了。
senses.why: By itself pushes the self-image to its limit: no helper is in the picture.
senses.whyCN: by itself 把「自己」推到极限：画面里没有任何帮手。

senses.title: Being the essence
senses.definition: used with in to say what something is when considered alone
senses.definitionCN: 与 in 连用，表示单看它本身的性质
senses.example: The offer is not bad in itself, but the timing is wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 这个提议本身不坏，只是时机不对。
senses.why: In itself takes the thing out of its context and looks at it alone.
senses.whyCN: in itself 把这件东西从情境里拿出来单独看。

senses.title: Returning to a state
senses.definition: used to say that a thing or person has come back to its normal state
senses.definitionCN: 表示某物或某人回到了常态
senses.example: The market slowly righted itself after the shock.
senses.exampleCN: 市场在冲击之后慢慢恢复过来。
senses.why: Something that rights itself has folded back to where it began.
senses.whyCN: 能一下扶正自己的东西，是折回了原来的位置。

intro.en: Itself is a compound made in English from it and self, after the pattern of himself and herself.
intro.cn: itself 是英语内部用 it 与 self 复合而成，模仿了 himself 与 herself 的模式。

items.en: Self was a separate noun and adjective for the same very person.
items.cn: self 原来自成名词和形容词，表示「正是本人」。

items.en: The pronoun was hit, so the compound shape came later.
items.cn: 当时的代词是 hit，所以这种复合形式出现较晚。

items.en: Reflexive forms such as himself and herself were already common.
items.cn: 反身形式如 himself、herself 已很常见。

items.en: Itself appeared as it replaced hit in ordinary speech.
items.cn: it 取代 hit 之后，itself 才出现。

items.en: The by itself and in itself phrases fixed in modern usage.
items.cn: by itself 与 in itself 这些说法在现代用法里固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the it- family with self; the near-meaning group holds other reflexive pronouns.
note.cn: 形近组是 it 加 self 的词族；近义组收其他反身代词。

entries.definition: Belonging to it.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格形式，义为「它的」，与本词只差 self。

entries.definition: The pronoun for a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 基础代词，义为「它」，是本词的前半。

entries.definition: A person's own nature or body.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「自身」，是本词的后半。

entries.definition: Those same things or people, as a plural.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「它们自己」，用于复数。

entries.definition: That same male person.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「他自己」，itself 的模仿对象。

entries.definition: That same female person.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「她自己」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the mirror image and the three fixed phrases by itself, in itself, and for itself.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用镜子画面，以及 by itself、in itself、for itself 三个固定说法。

normal.en: Itself is it plus self, like himself and herself.
normal.cn: itself 就是 it 加 self，与 himself、herself 同构。

normal.en: Self was once a separate word for the very person.
normal.cn: self 原先是表示「正是本人」的独立词。

normal.en: By itself means with nobody's help.
normal.cn: by itself 意为没有别人帮忙。

normal.en: In itself means considered alone.
normal.cn: in itself 意为单看它本身。

normal.en: Reflexive forms appeared after it replaced hit.
normal.cn: 反身形式是在 it 取代 hit 之后才有的。

abstract.en: Itself is a mirror in front of the thing.
abstract.cn: itself 就是立在那东西面前的一面镜子。

abstract.en: The machine that starts itself needs no hand.
abstract.cn: 会自己启动的机器不需要人的手。

abstract.en: What is old in itself may still be new inside.
abstract.cn: 本身很旧的东西，里面仍可能是新的。

examples.en: The problem will not solve itself.
examples.cn: 这个问题不会自己解决。

examples.en: The house itself is small, but the garden is huge.
examples.cn: 房子本身不大，但花园很大。

examples.en: The lamp switches itself off at midnight.
examples.cn: 这盏灯到午夜会自动关掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一特塞奥夫」—— 一件东西特意把自己塞回自己身边

root: 古英语 self「本人；自身」（独立词）→ 中古英语 himself、herself 等反身形式 → 现代英语 it 加 self 构成 itself。同族有 it、its、self。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses: the same thing acting, emphatic itself, acting alone, considered in essence, and returning to a normal state.
sensesIntro.cn: 五种用法：同一事物自身施动、强调本身、独自行动、本质上如何，以及恢复常态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mirror standing before an object, identical inside and out.
core.cn: 核心意象：镜子立在物体前，镜内镜外一样。

branches.en: THE DOOR: the wind pushes it into itself.
branches.cn: 门这条线：风把它推回自己身上。

branches.en: THE BUILDING: old walls, new rooms.
branches.cn: 建筑这条线：旧墙与新房间。

branches.en: THE CHILD: buttons done without help.
branches.cn: 孩子这条线：不用人帮就扣上的扣子。

branches.en: THE OFFER: fair alone, wrong in timing.
branches.cn: 提议这条线：单看公道，时机不对。

branches.en: THE MARKET: shaken, then levelled again.
branches.cn: 市场这条线：震惊之后又回到原位。

intro.en: Itself joins two old English pieces, the pronoun it and the word self.
intro.cn: itself 把两块老英语成分拼在一起：代词 it 与 self。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the nearest Latin pattern is the reflexive suus, listed only for contrast.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，最接近的拉丁模式是反身词 suus，只作对照。

items.example: The possessive built on the same stem.
Kept as one word, never split.
items.exampleCN: 始终写成一个词，不拆开。

definition_zh: 夹克；短外套；（书）护封；（管道、锅炉的）外壳
definition_en: a short coat with sleeves, or an outer cover around a book, machine, or pipe
core_image: 一件短外套搭在椅背上，袖口还留着上一位主人的形状
scene: 秋天的早晨有点凉，他把一件短外套从衣架上取下来披上。He grabbed a light jacket before leaving the house.
sceneCN: 这里 jacket 是「夹克」（第 1 个义项：有袖的短外套），句意为出门前他抓起一件薄夹克。画面里的物件：衣架、短外套、清晨的凉意。

pos.zh: 名词：夹克；短外套；护封；外壳
动词：给……加护封；给……加外壳

derivatives.zh: 由 jacket 加 -ed 构成，义为「穿外套的；有外壳的」
由 jacket 加 -ing 构成，义为「外套材料；护套」
由 jacket 加 -less 构成，义为「没穿外套的」

senses.title: A short coat
senses.definition: a short coat with sleeves that reaches only to the hips or waist
senses.definitionCN: 有袖子、只到臀部或腰部的短外套
senses.example: He wore a denim jacket to the concert.
senses.exampleCN: 他穿了件牛仔夹克去听演唱会。
senses.why: The clothing sense is the earliest recorded use in French, naming a short tunic.
senses.whyCN: 衣物义是法语里最早有记录的用法，指一种短上衣。

senses.title: A protective cover
senses.definition: an outer casing fitted around a machine part, pipe, or tank to protect or cool it
senses.definitionCN: 包在机械零件、管道或贮罐外起保护或冷却作用的外层
senses.example: The boiler jacket keeps the heat inside.
senses.exampleCN: 锅炉外壳把热量留在里面。
senses.why: A jacket on a machine is a coat put on an object, so the clothing image transfers directly.
senses.whyCN: 机器上的 jacket 就是给物件穿的外套，衣物的画面直接搬了过去。

senses.title: A book's paper cover
senses.definition: the loose paper cover wrapped around a hardback book
senses.definitionCN: 包在精装书外面的那层可拆纸质封面
senses.example: The dust jacket is torn at the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 护封的角上撕破了。
senses.why: The paper cover dresses the book the way a jacket dresses a body.
senses.whyCN: 纸封面给书穿衣，就像夹克给人穿衣。

senses.title: An outer skin of a cable
senses.definition: the insulating layer around electrical wires or a cable
senses.definitionCN: 包在电线或电缆外面的绝缘层
senses.example: The cable jacket was cut, so the wire was replaced.
senses.exampleCN: 电缆护套破了，于是换掉了那根线。
senses.why: Insulation is another protective coat, keeping danger inside the cable.
senses.whyCN: 绝缘层又是一层保护衣，把危险留在电缆里。

senses.title: To cover with a jacket
senses.definition: to fit or cover something with a jacket or an outer layer
senses.definitionCN: 给某物装外套或加上外层
senses.example: Workers jacketed the pipes before winter.
senses.exampleCN: 入冬前工人给管道加上了外壳。
senses.why: The verb simply puts the coat on, the literal action behind the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是把外套穿上，是名词背后的字面动作。

intro.en: Jacket came from Old French jaquette, a small jaque, which named a short tunic or coat of mail.
intro.cn: jacket 来自古法语 jaquette，是 jaque 的指小形式，指短的束腰衣或锁子甲衣。

items.en: jaque named a short tunic worn by soldiers.
items.cn: jaque 指士兵穿的短上衣。

items.en: -ette is a diminutive ending, so jaquette was a little jaque.
items.cn: 古法语 -ette 是指小词尾，jaquette 即小的 jaque。

items.en: Medieval records give jacottus or jacquetus for a short coat.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁文献写作 jacottus 或 jacquetus，指短外衣。

items.en: English borrowed jacket for a short coat, often of leather or mail.
items.cn: 英语借入 jacket，指短外衣，常为皮制或甲制。

items.en: The word spread to book covers, pipes, and machine casings.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩展到书封、管道与机器外壳。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on the jack- shape; the near-meaning group holds outer garments and covers.
note.cn: 形近组是 jack- 开头的词形；近义组收外衣与外壳类词。

entries.definition: Wearing a jacket, or fitted with a casing.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「穿着外套的；有外壳的」。

entries.definition: Material used to cover pipes.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「护套材料」，同族名词。

entries.definition: Without a jacket.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -less 构成，义为「没穿外套的」。

entries.definition: A longer outer garment with sleeves.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「外套」，通常比 jacket 长。

entries.definition: A knitted jumper that opens at the front.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「开衫」，针织面料，前开扣。

entries.definition: Something that lies over or around a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「覆盖物」，最宽泛的外壳类词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the small tunic jaquette into pipes, books, and cables.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子跟着小小的 jaquette 走到管道、书本与电缆上。

normal.en: Old French jaque was a short soldier's tunic.
normal.cn: 古法语 jaque 是士兵的短上衣。

normal.en: The ending -ette makes it a small one.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ette 表示「小」。

normal.en: A dust jacket wraps a book like a coat.
normal.cn: dust jacket 像外套一样包住书。

normal.en: A life jacket is a jacket that keeps you up.
normal.cn: life jacket 是能让人浮起来的外套。

normal.en: A water jacket cools an engine with water.
normal.cn: water jacket 用水给发动机降温。

abstract.en: A jacket is the layer that goes over everything else.
abstract.cn: 夹克是穿在所有衣服外面的那一层。

abstract.en: A book put on a jacket is ready to be sold.
abstract.cn: 穿上护封的书才准备上市。

abstract.en: Every pipe needs a coat of its own.
abstract.cn: 每根管子都需要一件自己的外套。

examples.en: She zipped up her jacket against the wind.
examples.cn: 她拉上夹克拉链挡风。

examples.en: The book's jacket shows a photograph of the author.
examples.cn: 书的护封上印着作者的照片。

examples.en: The engine is enclosed in a water jacket.
examples.cn: 发动机被一个水套包住。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「夹克特」—— 特意夹在身上的短外套

root: 古法语 jaque「士兵的短上衣」+ -ette（指小词尾）→ jaquette → 中古拉丁 jacottus → 中古英语 jacket。同族有 jacketed、jacketing。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: a short coat, a machine casing, a book's paper cover, a cable sheath, and the verb of covering.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：短外套、机器外壳、书护封、电缆护套，以及加外壳的动词用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a short coat hanging on a chair, still holding its shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：搭在椅背的短外套，还保持着原来的形状。

branches.en: THE CONCERT: denim over a thin shirt.
branches.cn: 演唱会这条线：薄衬衫外的牛仔布。

branches.en: THE BOILER: a casing that keeps heat in.
branches.cn: 锅炉这条线：留住热量的外壳。

branches.en: THE BOOK: loose paper over a hard cover.
branches.cn: 书本这条线：包住硬封的活页纸。

branches.en: THE CABLE: insulation cut down to the wire.
branches.cn: 电缆这条线：被切到铁芯的绝缘层。

branches.en: THE PIPES: workers wrapping them before winter.
branches.cn: 管道这条线：入冬前工人给它们包上外层。

intro.en: Jacket is a French borrowing; English adds only the familiar endings after it.
intro.cn: jacket 是从法语借来的，后面的英语词尾都是后来添上的。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin took the French word as jacottus, and its relatives are few.
latinIntro.cn: 中古拉丁语把这个法语词写成 jacottus，其同族词不多。

items.exampleCN: 英语写作 jacket，而非 jaquette。

items.example: A jacket for a printed book.

definition_zh: 果酱；堵塞；拥挤；卡住；（无线电）干扰；塞满
definition_en: a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar, a crowd or blockage that stops movement, or to press something tightly into a space
core_image: 狭窄的巷口被一群人挤得水泄不通，谁也动不了
scene: 早高峰的路口，两侧的车都往前挤，最后谁都不动。The morning traffic jam stretched for two kilometres.
sceneCN: 这里 jam 是「堵塞」（第 1 个义项：人和车挤在一起无法移动），句意为早高峰的堵车队伍排了两公里。画面里的物件：路口、车流、红灯。

pos.zh: 名词：果酱；堵塞；拥挤；困境

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转形容词，义为「卡住的；挤满的」
由 jam 加 -ing 构成，义为「干扰；即兴合奏」
由 jam 加 -y 构成，义为「涂果酱的；幸运的」

senses.title: A blockage of traffic
senses.definition: a line of vehicles or people so crowded that they cannot move
senses.definitionCN: 车辆或人群挤到无法移动
senses.example: A jam at the bridge delayed every bus.
senses.exampleCN: 桥上的堵车让所有公交都晚了。
senses.why: The verb meant to press tightly, and a jam is the result of pressing a road full.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词本义是紧紧压住，堵塞就是把路压满的结果。

senses.title: A tight press of people
senses.definition: a crowd of people or things squeezed into a space too small for them
senses.definitionCN: 拥挤到超过空间容量的人群或物体
senses.example: There was a jam of fans at the stage door.
senses.exampleCN: 后台门口挤着一堆粉丝。
senses.why: Crowding is the same pressing action applied to people instead of vehicles.
senses.whyCN: 拥挤就是把「压」的动作用于人而不是车。

senses.title: Fruit boiled with sugar
senses.definition: a thick sweet spread made by boiling fruit with sugar
senses.definitionCN: 水果加糖煮成的浓稠甜酱
senses.example: She spread jam on the toast.
senses.exampleCN: 她在吐司上抹了果酱。
senses.why: The food sense has a different origin, likely from crushing fruit, but the word fused.
senses.whyCN: 食物义的来源不同，可能取自「压碎水果」，但词形融合在了一起。

senses.title: To squeeze into a space
senses.definition: to push something into a place with force so that it fits tightly
senses.definitionCN: 用力把东西推进某处使之紧紧塞住
senses.example: He jammed the clothes into the small case.
senses.exampleCN: 他把衣服硬塞进那只小箱子。
senses.why: This is the central physical sense: force something in until there is no play left.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的物理义：硬推进去直到不留余量。

senses.title: To be stuck
senses.definition: to become unable to move or work because a part is stuck
senses.definitionCN: 因部件卡住而不能移动或运转
senses.example: The printer jammed again in the night.
senses.exampleCN: 打印机夜里又卡纸了。
senses.why: Something jammed has been pressed until its parts cannot slide.
senses.whyCN: jam 住的东西被压到各部件无法滑动。

senses.title: To block a signal
senses.definition: to send out signals that stop a radio or other transmission being received
senses.definitionCN: 发出信号使电台等无法被接收
senses.example: Electronic noise jammed the radio in the tunnel.
senses.exampleCN: 电子噪声干扰了隧道里的收音机。
senses.why: Jamming fills a channel with noise the way a crowd fills a street.
senses.whyCN: 干扰就像人群填满街一样，把一条频道填满噪声。

intro.en: Jam in the sense of squeezing may echo a French dialect verb for pressing, while the fruit sense probably grows from crushing fruit; the exact path is debated.
intro.cn: 表示「挤压」的 jam 可能源自法语方言里「压」的动词，果酱义大概出自「把水果压碎」，具体路径仍有争议。

items.en: A dialect verb for pressing or squeezing sits behind the English verb.
items.cn: 英语动词背后可能有一个表示「压、挤」的法语方言动词。

items.en: English dialects used jam for squeezing or bruising fruit.
items.cn: 英语方言里 jam 指压挤、压伤水果。

items.en: The noun for a crowd or blocked street appears in the early nineteenth century records.
items.cn: 表示人群拥挤或街道堵塞的名词在十九世纪初见于记录。

items.en: jam as fruit boiled with sugar is recorded from the eighteenth century and spread in the next.
items.cn: 果酱义在十八世纪已有记录，之后普及。

items.en: Radio jamming joined the family in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 无线电干扰义在二十世纪加入这一词族。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the jam- shape; the near-meaning group holds words for jams, crowds, and squeezing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 jam- 词形；近义组收堵塞、拥挤与挤压类词。

entries.definition: Stuck or packed tight.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「卡住的；挤满的」。

entries.definition: Blocking signals, or playing music freely.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「干扰；即兴合奏」。

entries.definition: Covered with jam, or very lucky.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -y 构成，义为「抹了果酱的；幸好运的」。

entries.definition: To stop movement through a passage.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「阻挡」，比 jam 更强调阻止。

entries.definition: A large number of people in one place.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「人群」，只指人多。

entries.definition: To press something firmly from two sides.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「挤压」，力度更轻。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the physical squeeze as the centre and hang traffic, fruit, and jammed printers on it.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「硬压」这个物理动作放在中心，再挂上堵车、果酱与卡纸的打印机。

normal.en: To jam is to press something in until no gap is left.
normal.cn: jam 就是压进去直到不留缝。

normal.en: A traffic jam is a street pressed full of cars.
normal.cn: traffic jam 就是被车压满的街。

normal.en: Jam is fruit pressed and boiled with sugar.
normal.cn: jam 是压碎加糖煮的水果。

normal.en: A printer that jams has paper stuck inside.
normal.cn: 卡住的打印机里面有纸塞着。

normal.en: Jamming a radio fills its channel with noise.
normal.cn: 干扰收音机就是拿噪声填满频道。

abstract.en: A jam is a space that has lost all its gaps.
abstract.cn: 堵塞是失去全部缝隙的一处空间。

abstract.en: Everyone pushing forward is what stops everyone.
abstract.cn: 人人向前挤，正是人人不能动的原因。

abstract.en: Sweet jam begins with crushing hard fruit.
abstract.cn: 甜的果酱从压碎硬水果开始。

examples.en: We were stuck in a jam for forty minutes.
examples.cn: 我们堵在路上四十分钟。

examples.en: He jammed the papers into the drawer and left.
examples.cn: 他把文件塞进抽屉就走了。

examples.en: Pass me the jam, please.
examples.cn: 请把果酱递给我。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扎满」—— 人车扎得满满，一点空隙都没有

root: 源自法语／英语方言表示「压、挤」的动词 → 英语 jam「挤压」→ 拥挤、堵塞、卡住、果酱、干扰。同族有 jammed、jamming、traffic jam。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses: traffic blockage, a crowd, fruit jam, squeezing something in, being stuck, and signal interference.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项：交通堵塞、人群拥挤、果酱、把东西塞满、卡住，以及信号干扰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow lane packed so tight that nobody can move.
core.cn: 核心意象：狭窄的巷口被挤得谁也动不了。

branches.en: THE BRIDGE: cars nose to nose for two kilometres.
branches.cn: 桥这条线：两公里的车首尾相接。

branches.en: THE DOOR: fans pressed against a stage entrance.
branches.cn: 门口这条线：粉丝挤在后台门前。

branches.en: THE TOAST: crushed fruit turned sweet and thick.
branches.cn: 吐司这条线：压碎的果子变甜变稠。

branches.en: THE CASE AND THE PRINTER: pushed in until stuck.
branches.cn: 箱子与打印机这条线：推到卡住为止。

branches.en: THE TUNNEL: noise filling a radio channel.
branches.cn: 隧道这条线：噪声填满收音频道。

intro.en: Jam is a short English word with no classical prefix; its endings are all English.
intro.cn: jam 是简短的英语词，没有古典词缀，所有词尾都是英语的。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for jam, so latinEntries is empty; the dotted form jam. shows the word is a whole noun.
latinIntro.cn: jam 没有拉丁语来源，latinEntries 留空；带点的 jam. 表示它是一个完整名词。

items.example: The central meaning of the word.
Dictionaries write jam. to show sense number.
items.exampleCN: 词典用 jam. 来标出义项序号。

definition_zh: 工作；职业；任务；活儿；职位
definition_en: the paid work that someone does regularly, or one particular task that has to be done
core_image: 一张排满格子的日程表，每格都写着待办的事
scene: 面试结束后，她站在走廊里等电梯，手里还捏着简历。She spent three months looking for a job in the city.
sceneCN: 这里 job 是「工作、职业」（第 1 个义项：为取得报酬而长期做的事），句意为她在这座城市找工作找了三个月。画面里的物件：走廊、电梯、简历。

pos.zh: 名词：工作；职业；职位；任务；活儿

derivatives.zh: 由 job 加 -less 构成，义为「失业的」
由 job 加 -ing 构成，义为「打零工的；做零活的」
由 job 加 -er 构成，指散户经纪或做零活的人

senses.title: Paid work done regularly
senses.definition: the regular paid work that a person does to earn a living
senses.definitionCN: 一个人为谋生而长期从事的有偿工作
senses.example: She found a job in a bookshop near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她在车站附近的书店找到了一份工作。
senses.why: The core sense is regular paid work, the thing a person most often asks another about.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是长期有偿工作，也就是人们最常问起的那件事。

senses.title: A position in a firm
senses.definition: a particular post or opening that someone can be hired to fill
senses.definitionCN: 某个可以被雇用填补的具体岗位
senses.example: Fifty people applied for the job.
senses.exampleCN: 有五十人申请这个岗位。
senses.why: A job can be seen as a slot to be filled, separate from the person filling it.
senses.whyCN: job 也能被看作一个待填的位置，与填它的人分开。

senses.title: A single task
senses.definition: one particular piece of work that must be finished
senses.definitionCN: 一件必须完成的特定工作
senses.example: Cleaning the gutters is a nasty job.
senses.exampleCN: 清理屋檐水槽是件麻烦的任务。
senses.why: The countable task sense narrows regular work down to one piece of it.
senses.whyCN: 可数的任务义把长期工作缩成其中的一件。

senses.title: Quality of work done
senses.definition: the standard or quality of a piece of work, as in doing a good job
senses.definitionCN: 某项工作的水准，如「干得好」
senses.example: You did a good job on that report.
senses.exampleCN: 那份报告你写得不错。
senses.why: Judging how a job was done blends the task sense with an evaluation.
senses.whyCN: 评价活儿干得怎么样，是任务义与评价的融合。

senses.title: A fixed duty or role
senses.definition: something treated as a duty that belongs to a person
senses.definitionCN: 被视为某人分内应做的事
senses.example: It is not my job to answer the phone.
senses.exampleCN: 接电话不是我的职责。
senses.why: When a duty is assigned, the word slides from the work to the person expected to do it.
senses.whyCN: 当职责被指派时，这个词就从工作滑到了该做工作的人身上。

senses.title: To work by the piece
senses.definition: to do small or piece-rate work, often casually
senses.definitionCN: 做零散或计件的工作，多为临时性质
senses.example: He jobbed on building sites for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 他在工地打了一年零工。
senses.why: The verb keeps only the piecework shadow of the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词只保留了名词「零活」的那道影子。

intro.en: Job is a word of uncertain origin; the usual view links it to a lump or piece of work, but the earlier steps are disputed.
intro.cn: job 的来源一般认为不确定；常见看法把它连到「一块、一桩」的活儿，但更早的脉络尚有争议。

items.en: The word appears in English in the sixteenth century with the sense of a piece of work.
items.cn: 这个词十六世纪出现于英语，义为「一桩活儿」。

items.en: Some scholars connect it with gob, a lump or mass, meaning a lump of work.
items.cn: 一些学者把它连到 gob「一块、一团」，意为一团活儿。

items.en: Others treat it as unrelated slang of unknown source.
items.cn: 另一些人认为它是来源不明的俚语，与此无关。

items.en: By the seventeenth century it meant regular paid employment.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，它已指长期的有偿雇用。

items.en: The verb and the phrases do a good job spread in the modern period.
items.cn: 动词用法与 do a good job 一类说法在近现代铺开。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words that are easy to confuse with job; the near-meaning group holds other words for work and tasks.
note.cn: 形近组收容易与 job 混看的短词；近义组收表示工作与任务的其他词。

entries.definition: To run slowly and steadily.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写只差一个字母，义为「慢跑」，来源不同。

entries.definition: To write something down quickly.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写相近，义为「匆匆记下」，来源不同。

entries.definition: A shrub grown for its oil.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写相近的植物名，来源完全不同。

entries.definition: Activity done to achieve a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 不可数的「工作」，范围比 job 宽。

entries.definition: The whole course of a working life.
entries.definitionCN: 指整个职业生涯，比 job 长。

entries.definition: One piece of work to be done.
entries.definitionCN: 指一项具体任务，与第 3 个义项最近。

entries.definition: A particular position of employment.
entries.definitionCN: 较正式的「职位」，与第 2 个义项相近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a lump of work to a slot in the job market.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从「一团活儿」走到就业市场里的一个空位。

normal.en: Job is countable, so we say a job and two jobs.
normal.cn: job 可数，说 a job、two jobs。

normal.en: Work is usually uncountable, which is the classic contrast.
normal.cn: work 通常不可数，这是最经典的对比。

normal.en: A job interview is where a person meets a post.
normal.cn: job interview 是人去会一个岗位的场合。

normal.en: Do a good job judges the task, not the post.
normal.cn: do a good job 评的是活儿，不是岗位。

normal.en: Jobless adds -less to turn the noun into an adjective.
normal.cn: jobless 加 -less 把名词变成形容词。

abstract.en: A job is a box on a timetable that someone pays to fill.
abstract.cn: 工作是日程表上有人付钱让人填的一格。

abstract.en: The same word covers a life and an afternoon.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指一辈子也指一个下午。

abstract.en: Every task is a small job inside a big one.
abstract.cn: 每项任务都是大活儿里的小活儿。

examples.en: He took a job at a small factory.
examples.cn: 他在一家小厂找了份工作。

examples.en: Finishing the roof was a two-day job.
examples.cn: 修完屋顶是两天的活儿。

examples.en: She did a fine job of explaining the rules.
examples.cn: 她把规则解释得很清楚。
